enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain asleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Breathe steadily.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, stretching and checking phone messages in bed (Bathroom is occupied by Member 2)
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Stretch arms above head. Yawn. Sit up in bed. Reach for phone on nightstand. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock screen. Open messaging app. Scroll through messages. Read messages. Put phone down. Stretch back. Lie back down.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face and brushing teeth, getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub soap on hands. Apply soap to face. Rinse face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open cabinet. Take out mug. Place mug on counter. Take out tea bag. Put tea bag in mug. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Pour milk into mug. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Talk with Member 2. Drink tea. Finish eating.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag and laptop for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place charger in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Unlock office door. Turn on lights. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone calls. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss program details. Coordinate with colleagues. Update program database. Print documents. File documents.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to lunch place. Order food. Pay for food. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Check phone. Drink water. Throw away trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, planning community events and meeting with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open event planning software. Review event details. Make phone calls to partners. Send emails. Attend meeting with partner organizations. Discuss logistics. Take notes. Update event schedule. Print flyers. Distribute flyers. Coordinate with team.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Greet Member 2. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on cutting board. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plates. Place plates on table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 2. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Clear plates from table. Scrape food into trash. Place plates in sink. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load cups. Load utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wash pots by hand. Rinse pots. Dry pots. Put pots away. Wipe counter with cloth. Sweep floor.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer to review next day's program schedule and check phone messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Log in. Open calendar. Review next day's schedule. Make notes. Open messaging app on phone. Check messages. Reply to messages. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select program. Watch TV. Talk with Member 2. Adjust volume. Change channel. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly and enjoying personal downtime (Bathroom is in use by Member 2)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up book from nightstand. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Place bookmark. Close book. Put book down. Stretch.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Remain asleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
